''See also: [[Enforcer Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|An Enforcer is a type of [[sacred artist]] whose [[spirit]] is defined by the role of a guardian or protector. These individuals are specialized in using their [[madra]] to enhance their physical capabilities, granting them superior strength, speed, and durability compared to others at the same level. This specialization is often represented by a badge featuring a shield icon. [[Enforcers]] utilize various techniques to manipulate their [[madra]] for combat and utility. While many employ full-body techniques to bolster their entire physical form, others use specialized methods that focus on specific actions, such as single strikes, rapid movement, or reinforcing weapons. These techniques can be highly taxing, often causing physical strain, muscle damage, or intense heat within the body. Some advanced techniques can even be used to mask movements or manipulate perceptions of distance and speed. In addition to combat, [[Enforcer techniques]] can be used for practical purposes, such as anchoring oneself to the ground or suppressing physical pain.}}
